The combination of declining assets, liquidity issues, escalating debt, reduced profitability, and significant losses demonstrates a negative trend. The drastic decline in net income and the considerable decrease in shareholder equity are particularly alarming. The sentiment score of -0.75 reflects this serious downturn in financial performance.
